latticegen.help: Writes a state file with a surrogate simple cubic lattice hopping model (sites at (i+1/2)a, periodic box, pairs with Marcus parameters), e.g. to test time-of-flight methods. Setup as in Chen, van der Hoorn, Baumeier, arXiv:2405.15836.

job_name.help: Input file name without extension, also used for the default state file name

statefile.help: State file to create, if not given job_name.hdf5

energyfile.help: Optional ASCII file with positions and site energies

dims.help: Number of sites along x, y and z

cutoff.help: Pairs are created for distances smaller than this (1.5 a: 6 nearest and 12 next-nearest neighbours)

J2.help: Squared coupling |J|^2 at distance a; |J|^2(r) = J2 exp(-(r-a)/decaylength)

states.help: Carrier types for which the parameters are written

segmentname.help: Segment type name of the sites

disorder.help: none: all equal to mean; uncorrelated: Gaussian iid; correlated: moving average of three Gaussian fields over the l_b and l_c nearest sites

sigma.help: Standard deviation of the site energies

eta_a.help: Correlated disorder: weight of the uncorrelated part

eta_b.help: Correlated disorder: weight of the short-range average (the long-range part has 1-eta_a-eta_b)

l_b.help: Correlated disorder: number of neighbours in the short-range average

l_c.help: Correlated disorder: number of neighbours in the long-range average

includeself.help: Correlated disorder: the l_b and l_c sites of the averages include the site itself (Baumeier et al., Phys. Rev. B 86, 184202 (2012)); false: the l_b and l_c nearest other sites (eq. 2.5 of Chen et al., arXiv:2405.15836)

seed.help: Seed of the random numbers (the same lattice on every platform)
